title: keeps a figure being typed over a field the record has not moved (issue 659)
why: The typed figure dropped as the record arrives: a theme pressed just before puts the field back under the person's hands, and the Enter that follows commits the old number, so nothing is refused or drawn.

title: keeps the typed figure, so its Enter is refused beside the field (issue 659)
why: The same, through cell 04 itself: the record that a theme's write brings back puts the engine's 7 under a typed 30, and the Enter commits 7.

title: keeps a figure being typed over a field the record has not moved (issue 659)
why: A typed figure kept over a field the record has moved itself: the field shows a number the record no longer holds under it.
